paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between “testing k” and correlation values for two different consistency approaches. The x-axis is labeled “testing k” with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 9, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Correlation” with a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. A red line, marked with square data points and a solid line style, represents “Consistency-Bi”, starting at a correlation value of approximately 0.92 at testing k = 1 and decreasing to a correlation value of approximately 0.90 at testing k = 9. A blue dashed line, marked with circle data points and a dashed line style, represents “Consistency-CE”, starting at a correlation value of approximately 0.61 at testing k = 1 and increasing to a correlation value of approximately 0.76 at testing k = 9.
